blurb: "In extraordinary recent paintings by Jean-Pierre Roy, purposeful men and women wrestle with amorphous forms, struggling to position them, or make adjustments to their actions. Sometimes the forms are geometrically structured, sometimes they are fungoid. They are always alien. What are these strange biomechanical devices?
